title: [finding] four more exported spec types resolve to `unknown` while their TSDoc promises a shape — `ViewMetadataParsed`, `InlineAction`, `AssembledViewArtifact`, `JoinedReportBlock` (the #19871 class, other sites)
body:
Filing gate: **① defects with named landing sites**. Finding class **(b)**: a published type whose TSDoc declares a shape the type does not carry, so any value type-checks. Same class as #19871 (`ViewMetadata`, PR #19919). The sites below are other symbols, and each needs its own fix shape.

Found by the `os-dev` round on #19871, from a TypeScript compiler-API census over 2359 exported aliases in `packages/spec`. It found 11 aliases resolving to `unknown` before that PR and 10 after. Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat 1 (`session_013RDBh5DqXd2xnLwvHLgLFr`, seat post #6017). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The sites

Declarations were re-read by this seat on `origin/main` `beac798026`. The `unknown` readings and the causes are the round's.

| exported type | declaration | cause (the round's reading) | TSDoc / docs promise |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `ViewMetadataParsed` | `ui/view.zod.ts`: `z.infer<typeof ViewMetadataSchema>` | `z.infer` of a union whose members are cast to `z.ZodTypeAny` | 「Post-parse shape of ViewMetadata」 |
| `InlineAction` | `ui/action.zod.ts`: `z.input<typeof InlineActionSchema>` | the input type of a `lazySchema(z.preprocess(…))` is `unknown` | the pre-parse shape; `references/ui/action.mdx` advertises it |
| `AssembledViewArtifact` (and `…Parsed`) | `ui/assembled-views.zod.ts`: `z.input<typeof AssembledViewArtifactSchema>` | a union of `VIEW_METADATA_MEMBERS` values cast to `z.ZodTypeAny` | 「One assembled `viewItems:` entry (input shape)」; exported from the root index |
| `JoinedReportBlock` | `ui/report.zod.ts`: `z.input<typeof JoinedReportBlockSchema>` | the schema is annotated `z.ZodTypeAny` | `references/ui/report.mdx` advertises its shape |

⚠️ `ViewMetadataParsed` is not a one-line fix. `diagnoseViewMetadata` returns `data: parsed.data` (`unknown`), which is not assignable to the members' output union (TS2322, measured by the round). That function needs an edit too.

## Why it matters

A TypeScript author, or an AI writing typed code, who annotates with one of these names gets no checking at all, while the name and TSDoc say otherwise. `check:exported-any` reads `ZodType<any>` annotations only, so no gate sees an alias that resolves to `unknown` (the round noted a ~60-line compiler-API census could become one). The runtime parse still refuses bad bodies, so no wrong data reaches a store.

Named producers: TypeScript consumers of `@objectstack/spec` who annotate with these types. No in-repo consumer outside spec tests was found for any of the four.

## Suggested shape (⛔ not a ruling)

Per site, derive the type from the member schemas, as PR #19919 does for `ViewMetadata`. Where the `ZodTypeAny` cast exists to dodge TS7056 or declaration size, measure that cost first. #19324 showed that cost can be real.

## Dedupe

MCP issue search, this repo, at 2026-09-23T19:26Z: `exported type resolves to unknown InlineAction JoinedReportBlock AssembledViewArtifact ZodTypeAny` returned 1 hit, #19871 (the `ViewMetadata` site, a different symbol).
